args.summary: Completed and generated the checked OpenSeesPy model for the 5-span (35+40+40+40+35 m) continuous precast T-girder bridge, with six C50 girders per span and girder self weight only. The integrated single-girder section has A=1.022 m² and I=0.85655 m⁴; the six-girder line has A=6.132 m², I=5.13933 m⁴, and self-weight 159.432 kN/m. The first vertical frequency is 3.485 Hz and JTG D60 impact factor is 0.2049. Model generation succeeded with L1 topology, L2 code and L3 mechanics checks. OpenSeesPy results: maximum lane positive moment 11,938 kN·m and maximum lane negative moment −9,610 kN·m.
